Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. All Bidders Mandatory to Attend pree bid meet and show sample of the products 1. Scope of Work ●The scope of this procurement shall include the supply, fabrication, assembly, integration and testing of drone-related components and equipment, strictly as specified in the BOQ and technical specifications uploaded with the bid. ●The items may include GPS modules, camera and gimbal systems, flight controllers, motors, propellers, electronic controllers, motherboard assemblies and other associated components. 2. Technical Compliance ●The bidder shall ensure that all offered products conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the BOQ. ●All components shall be new, unused and free from manufacturing defects. ●Any deviation from the prescribed specifications must be clearly highlighted in the technical bid. ●The buyer reserves the right to reject products that do not meet the prescribed specifications. 3. Quality and Standards ●All supplied items shall be of appropriate industrial quality and suitable for their intended application. ●Electronic components shall be tested for proper functionality before delivery. ●Components shall be compatible with the intended drone assembly wherever integration is part of the sc ope. ●The supplier shall ensure that no refurbished, used or counterfeit components are supplied. 4. Documents to be Submitted

The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the technical bid, wherever applicable: ●GST Registration Certificate. ●PAN Card. ●Firm registration/proprietorship/company registration proof. ●Product catalogues. ●OEM authorization certificate, wherever applicable. ●Undertaking regarding supply of genuine and new products. ●Details of previous experience, if available. 5. Delivery Period ●The complete supply shall be made within 30 days from the date of issuance of the GeM contract. ●Delivery shall be made at the consignee location specified in the GeM contract. ●The supplier shall ensure safe transportation and timely delivery of all items. ●Any anticipated delay shall be communicated to the buyer in advance. 6. Inspection and Acceptance ●All supplied items shall be subject to inspection by the buyer or an authorized inspection representative. ●The buyer reserves the right to verify quantity, quality, specifications and functionality of supplied produ cts. ●Any item found damaged, defective or not conforming to the specifications shall be replaced by the supp lier without additional cost. ●Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection and verification. 7. Warranty Additional Terms and Conditions Page 1●The supplied products shall carry a minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of successful d elivery and acceptance. ●During the warranty period, manufacturing defects or functional failures shall be rectified or the affected items replaced without additional cost. ●Warranty support shall be provided by the supplier/OEM as applicable. 8. Packaging and Transportation ●All items shall be properly packed to prevent damage during transportation and handling. ●Sensitive electronic components shall be packed using suitable protective and anti-static packaging whe rever required. ●Transportation, loading, unloading and insurance costs shall be borne by the supplier and included in the quoted price unless otherwise specified in the BOQ. 9. Payment Terms ● Payment shall be processed through the GeM portal after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance o f the supplied goods, subject to submission of the required invoice and supporting documents and applicable Ge M payment provisions.

10. Price and Taxes ●The quoted price shall include all applicable costs, including packaging, transportation, insurance and ot her incidental expenses. ●GST shall be quoted as applicable in accordance with the GeM bid and prevailing tax provisions. ●No additional charges shall be entertained beyond the accepted contract value, except as permitted und er the contract and applicable GeM provisions. 11. Replacement of Defective Goods The supplier shall replace any defective, damaged, incomplete or non-conforming item within 15 days of r eceiving written intimation from the buyer, without any additional financial liability to the buyer. 12. Bid Validity ● The bid shall remain valid for 90 days from the date of opening of the bid, unless otherwise specified in the GeM bid. 13. General Conditions ●The bidder shall comply with all applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC). ●The bidder shall comply with applicable Government of India procurement rules and regulations. ●The buyer reserves the right to verify the credentials and documents submitted by the bidder. ●Any misrepresentation, submission of forged documents or supply of counterfeit products may result in a ction as per applicable rules. ●The buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any offer in accordance with applicable procurement rule s and GeM provisions. ●All disputes shall be governed by the applicable GeM contract terms and relevant laws of India. 14. Final Declaration ● Participation in the bid shall imply that the bidder has carefully examined the BOQ, technical specifications , ATC and applicable GeM conditions and agrees to comply with the contractual requirements. .
